text: Tommy Hilfiger is a brand of PVH Corp. (NYSE: PVH); per PVH's own 2026 proxy statement, its largest disclosed shareholders are FMR LLC (14.6%), Pzena Investment Management (14.0%), BlackRock (9.4%), Dimensional Fund Advisors (6.6%) and Vanguard Capital Management (5.2%). No state or sovereign-fund holder is listed among them.

source.name: PVH Corp., 2026 Proxy Statement (DEF 14A)
source.quote: the persons who are known by us to be the beneficial owners of more than five percent of our common stock as of the record date for the meeting
